subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Assistir, em vídeo digital, a postagem de vlog infantil de críticas de brinquedos e livros de literatura infantil e, a partir dele, planejar e produzir resenhas digitais em áudio ou vídeo.

components.description_pt: Assistir posts de vídeo digital de vlogs infantis que resenham brinquedos ou literatura infantil como modelos
components.description_en: View digital video posts from children's vlogs reviewing toys or children's literature as models
components.cc_component_description: Identify key details from information presented through media such as audio or video

components.description_pt: Planejar conteúdo de resenha em formato áudio ou vídeo baseado em modelos de vlogs
components.description_en: Plan digital review content in audio or video format based on vlog models
components.cc_component_description: Use digital tools to draft and format informational or argumentative writing

components.description_pt: Produzir uma resenha digital em formato áudio ou vídeo seguindo convenções observadas em vlogs infantis
components.description_en: Produce a digital review in audio or video format following the conventions observed in children's vlogs
components.cc_component_description: Use digital tools to produce and format a piece of writing for publication

cc_matches.description: Ask and answer questions about key details in a text read aloud or information presented orally or through other media.
Use technology, including the Internet, to produce and publish writing and to interact and collaborate with others.
Use technology, including the Internet, to produce and publish writing and present the relationships between information and ideas clearly and efficiently.
